authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10286 mṛttikā gives Pali mattikā, Prakrit maṭṭī/mittiā, Punjabi/Hindi miṭṭī and eastern māṭi “earth, clay”; its Kachchi addendum explicitly includes “dust”. Clay/earth used for mud is the same material family, with local transmission left open.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13276 sarva gives Pali sabba, Prakrit savva, Hindi/Nepali sab, Punjabi sabh, Oriya sabu and Lahnda habh/habbā. The article explicitly discusses irregular pronoun developments and borrowing in some languages; the supported all/whole family is linked without resolving local transmission.
